approval_source: Researcher explicitly adopted this sequence and reporting plan in the conversation
scope: Approved analysis and decision rules; executable training readiness is separate

arms.E2: E1 architecture plus 512 verified, source-matched random background crops
arms.E3: E1 architecture plus 512 verified, source-matched model-guided hard background crops

seed_policy.seed17_role: Technical sanity and protocol-compliance review; not an efficacy gate
seed_policy.technical_failures: Preserve the failed attempt, record the defect and prospective repair; technical correctness may gate execution, disappointing valid performance may not
seed_policy.missing_runs: Report missing or failed runs explicitly; do not fabricate, impute, or silently omit seed results

sequence: Finish and freeze executable controls before controlled training
Review architecture, initialization, dataloader, training logs, validation evaluator and no-Test compliance
E0 seeds 42 and 123, and E1 seeds 42 and 123, regardless of score direction
Prepare and independently verify matched Train-only negative bundles

architecture.contrast: E1 minus E0, paired by training seed
architecture.meaning: Effect of the declared whole P2 architecture variant under matched controls

primary_negative_selection.contrast: E3 minus E2, paired by training seed
primary_negative_selection.meaning: Effect of the negative-location selection procedure with matched negative sample count, source frequencies, crop size and training/update schedule

secondary_random_augmentation.contrast: E2 minus E1, paired by training seed
secondary_random_augmentation.meaning: Overall effect of adding random background crops; added data and update budget may differ from E1

secondary_hard_augmentation.contrast: E3 minus E1, paired by training seed
secondary_hard_augmentation.meaning: Overall hard-negative augmentation effect; does not isolate hardness from added examples or updates

negative_control_matching.review: Every selected negative must be independently verified UAV-free, including context; annotation absence is insufficient
negative_control_matching.initialization: Train each E2/E3 arm from the matched public initialization; E1 proposes candidates, not the starting fine-tuned checkpoint
negative_control_matching.bundle_identity: Freeze the matched crop manifests and hashes before E2/E3; retain a fixed bundle across training seeds
negative_control_matching.implementation_status: Pending YOLO26 integration and bundle verification; no negative-pool results claimed

evaluation_policy.clean_v2_test_history: Already evaluated in the saved descriptive matrix; never relabel as an untouched holdout
evaluation_policy.exact_checkpoint_selection_rule: Must be prospectively specified in the executable freeze; existing runner uses last.pt and must not be silently changed to best.pt
evaluation_policy.external_confirmation: Separate independent benchmark with a fully specified, sealed protocol before final inference
evaluation_policy.sampled_rgpt: Preliminary external validation only; do not relabel an exposed sample as untouched final confirmation

reporting.mean: Arithmetic mean over all three prespecified seeds
reporting.paired_differences: Report all three same-seed contrasts, their arithmetic mean and sample SD
reporting.units: State fraction versus percent, and percentage-point units for differences; keep count differences as counts
reporting.latency: Report only from a separately fixed and measured hardware/runtime/precision/batch/measurement protocol
reporting.uncertainty: Seed SD measures training variability, not frame/video sampling uncertainty or proof of significance
reporting.external_confidence_intervals: Prespecify the statistical unit and method in the external protocol; do not treat correlated frames as independent observations

result_status.local_adamw_run: Completed descriptive local baseline; not Controlled E0
result_status.controlled_e0_e3: No new completed controlled results supplied or created by this plan
result_status.external: No final external scores supplied or created by this plan

amendments: Do not edit this sealed version after outcomes; create a new version with timestamp, reason, changes and prior hash. Preserve failed attempts and outcome exposure history.
